visual_observations.observation: A blocky cyan truck rolls past a stylized geometric house as a simulated photo card rises into view.
A blocky stylized arm places a series of rectangular blocks onto a snapshot card on a desk.
An abstracted human figure constructed from simple primitives rocks rigidly back and forth holding a block rake.

audio_observations.observation: A male narrator explains that a camera mounted on a Dallas brush truck photographs houses in transit.
The narrator states that a resident contested an AI roof flag identified as flashing.

pacing: The voiceover proceeds clearly, but visual transitions rely on sluggish reveals of basic shapes.
comprehension: The core topic is easily followed via audio narration, though the geometric graphics remain vague.
weakest_interval: 22.5 to 28.5 seconds where a static floating snapshot and plain blocks fail to show actual roof inspection details.
dimensional_action: Replace primitive block assemblies with precise diagrams displaying actual street view AI bounding boxes and roof features.
defects: Eliminate crude geometric placeholder shapes in favor of clear illustrative technical diagrams.
Add explicit close-up visual examples showing the misidentified roof flashing rather than an ambiguous icon.
